testPolicy.text: Standardized test scores from the ACT or SAT are required for first-year applicants to the Columbus campus (applicants out of high school for two or more years by their term of enrollment are exempt). Ohio State superscores both tests; the ACT science section is not needed. Scores must arrive by the application deadline.

cost.totalIncludes: Student Financial Aid, Cost of Attendance 2026-2027, Columbus campus, incoming freshmen living on campus: direct costs (tuition and fees, plus the non-resident fee of 30,220 for non-Ohioans; housing and food) and indirect costs (books, supplies and equipment; miscellaneous personal; transportation; federal loan fees 40).

inState.note: tuition line is 'Tuition and fees'. The admissions basic-costs page lists billed 2026-27 Columbus tuition of 14,050 and housing and food of 15,738 (most common housing and dining program).

outOfState.note: tuition = tuition and fees 14,034 + non-resident fees 30,220

deadlines.early: November 1, 2026 (Early Action, autumn 2027; test by October 3 SAT or October 17 ACT)
deadlines.regular: January 15, 2027 (Regular Decision); financial aid priority date February 1; acceptance fee by May 1, 2027

facts.text: The Ohio State Tuition Guarantee freezes tuition and mandatory fees for four years for each entering class, and for Ohio residents it also freezes housing and dining costs.
Ohio State's admitted students had middle-50% scores of 27 to 33 on the ACT and 1280 to 1470 on the SAT; 80% of admits scored between 1180 and 1530 on the SAT.

Under Ohio's Guaranteed Admission Program, students in the top 5% of their high school class are guaranteed admission to the main campus of any Ohio public university if they meet deadlines; the top 10% are guaranteed admission if they meet the unconditional admission standard, or else may be admitted to a regional campus.
Non-Ohio residents pay a non-resident fee of 30,220 on top of tuition and fees of 14,034 in 2026-27, so the on-campus budget is 64,990 against 34,142 for Ohioans.
Most incoming first-years on the Columbus campus are required to live on campus for their first two years.
Ohio State does not accept first-year applications for the summer term, and Early Action (November 1) applies to the autumn term only.

notes: The Columbus campus CDS 2025-26 PDF (https://irp.osu.edu/sites/default/files/documents/2026/03/CDS-2025-2026-OSU-Columbus-Campus.pdf) was downloaded, but its figures are drawn as vector outlines with no text layer: pypdf and WebFetch return only the labels, so C1, C9, C12 and residency figures are null. The Buckeye Data Digest admissions page is a Tableau dashboard that curl cannot read. The admitted-student score ranges come from the admissions page and are not labeled with a year; they describe admitted, not enrolled, students and are kept as a fact. The date the test requirement took effect is not stated on the page. No institution-wide aid promise text verified (the Buckeye Opportunity program was not found on the pages opened).
